Scalar, centered fixed-point diagonal, and skew-symmetric projection squared norms are R0=(f−1)²/(n−1), R1=f(n−f)/(n−2), R3=(n−f−2t)/2; the orthogonal residual is R2≥0. Each orbit-frame sector eigenvalue is (n−1)M/n!·Rj/Dj, with coincident/zero levels retained. Rank requires R0,R1,R2,R3>0; the algebraic factorization of R2 and n=4 cycle types gives exact stated injectivity criterion. Independent orthonormal-matrix numerical enumeration of all conjugacy classes for n=4,5,6 reproduced eigenvalues/multiplicities. General C relies on the representation proof, not finitely many classes.
